subject: Post-call: Connectivity & Compliance Roadmap for CodaHealth
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@codahealth.com>, Leah Cho <leah.cho@codahealth.com>
Cc: infra-team@codahealth.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Connectivity & Compliance Roadmap for CodaHealth

Alex / Leah — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap while items are fresh and to align next steps. I know there was a lot to cover so I tried to keep this focused on the hard constraints and our immediate asks.

Summary of pain points & goals (as discussed)
- Data residency: all PHI must remain in CodaHealth-managed VPCs in us-west and cannot leave region for processing or logging.
- Air-gap option: procurement & security want an air-gapped/on-prem variant for the production ML inference path (audit requirement for certain customers).
- Network constraints: no public ingress to inference hosts; only outbound to a limited set of logging/ops egress IPs via proxy; strict firewall ACLs; only TLS 1.2+ approved.
- Audit & key management: KMS/HSM integration and per-request audit logs for each inference call; 12+ months retention for security logs.
- Latency: pilot target is <= 200ms p95 for typical requests; will need to validate with your typical prompt size.

What Redwood heard we can deliver (high-level)
- Private deployment options: VPC peering/Transit Gateway, Dedicated private tenancy, or an on-prem appliance bundle (air-gap) for full isolation.
- KMS: can integrate with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/HSM) and support envelope encryption.
- Logging: configurable push to your SIEM endpoint via secure outbound channels; we can redact PII at the SDK layer if needed.

Immediate asks / next steps (requested from CodaHealth)
1) Please share the proposed VPC CIDR(s) and expected NAT/proxy egress IPs for allowlisting. (action: Coda infra, ETA: 3 business days)
2) Identify the single technical owner we should schedule a 90-minute deep-dive with (network + security).
3) Confirm whether procurement requires an on-prem hardware BOM or if a software-only appliance is acceptable for air-gap proof-of-concept.
4) Please provide any SOC2 / internal audit checklist items that must be validated during pilot.

Attachments: I attached a short connectivity checklist and a draft mutual-action-plan (MAP) that maps tasks to owners/estimates.

I'll loop in Neha (security) and Marcus (deployment lead) to run the technical deep-dive once you confirm the owner and availability. Proposed window: next Tue/Wed (071/072) 10:00-12:00 PT.

Thanks — Rachel

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
